text:
Emma L.: Hey team — customer Acme Bio (acct: acm-77) says invoice #00012345 charged CA sales tax (8.25%). They say the billed branch is OR and should be tax-exempt with a submitted resale certificate. Can someone triage?

Jo (Support): I pulled the invoice, customer attached resale cert in the support case (case: 6221). The invoice has billing_entity_id: ENT-CA-1 but account_entity_id: ENT-OR-2. They provided a PO (PO-987) tied to the OR branch.

Raj P.: @Jo thanks — looking. Initial thought: tax engine precedence might be picking billing_entity over account_entity. That's by design historically, but we have an edge where parent company entity (CA) was set as billing_entity for consolidated billing.

Emma L.: Customer insists the purchase is for the OR branch (no state sales tax). They need a credit note and corrected invoice before renewal. They already declined the payment because tax changed the amount.

eng-tax-bot: Automated tax calc log (invoice 00012345):
```
{
  "invoice_id": "00012345",
  "account_id": "acm-77",
  "billing_entity_id": "ENT-CA-1",
  "account_entity_id": "ENT-OR-2",
  "tax_rate": "0.0825",
  "tax_total": "82.50",
  "tax_reason": "jurisdiction_based_on_billing_entity"
}
```

Raj P.: Repro steps I used: 1) Create account with primary entity ENT-OR-2, 2) Attach consolidated billing entity ENT-CA-1 at account level, 3) Generate invoice via API (/v1/invoices/create) with line item for OR-branch product. Tax engine currently resolves jurisdiction by billing_entity if present.

Jo (Support): Customer's PO explicitly references ENT-OR-2 and has resale cert id RC-449. Support case has attachment. We should treat PO entity as authority.

Maria F.: We need a quick remedial action: issue credit note for tax portion and regenerate invoice tied to ENT-OR-2. Finance OK to process credit once support confirms entitlement. Please add note referencing case 6221.

Raj P.: Short-term fix I can apply: manual override on invoice metadata to force tax_entity=ENT-OR-2 and re-run tax calculation. That will create a corrected invoice and we can issue a credit for the tax portion. Will need eng approval to run DB update.

Emma L.: Customer asked for ETA. Can we get a credit today?

Raj P.: I'll request DB change now. @Maria F. can you signoff to proceed with manual correction?

Maria F.: Signoff granted. Include adjustment reason: "tax jurisdiction misapplied due to consolidated billing mapping; resale cert on file."

eng-tax-bot: Change request logged: TAX-PRIORITY-312 — manual invoice override scheduled (operator: raj.p).

Jo (Support): Notifying customer that we will issue a credit and regenerate invoice. Keeping them updated.

Raj P.: Done — invoice 00012345 marked for override, new invoice 00012345-1 generated with tax_total: 0.00, reference credit_note CN-2048. I've left a comment in the invoice admin: "manual override: forced tax_entity ENT-OR-2 per PO-987 and RC-449."

Emma L.: Thanks — customer confirmed they got the corrected invoice and will approve payment.

Raj P.: Long-term: proposing change to tax resolution precedence — if PO entity or purchase-level entity exists and has matching resale/exemption, prefer it over consolidated billing entity. I'll file a follow-up RFC with eng-runtime + tax team.

Maria F.: Agree on RFC. Also recommend adding an automated check when an invoice's tax_total != expectation based on purchase-level entity and a resale cert exists; raise a warning before finalizing invoice.

Jo (Support): Closing loop on case 6221 after credit applied. Tagging for follow-up RFC: @raj.p @eng-tax-bot. :white_check_mark:

Emma L.: Thanks everyone. Customer happy.
